## About
River Hills Automotive is a family-owned and operated service station in Burnsville, taking care of drivers from Burnsville and the South Metro area. Our ASE-certified technicians handle diagnostics, repairs and factory-scheduled maintenance at a fair and just price.
We keep your service records on file and talk you through every estimate before we start. As one reviewer put it, Dave and his team are honest, trustworthy, and fair. Another said they never felt pressured.
Customers give us a 4.7 rating from 190 Google reviews. Stop by Cliff Road or give us a call, and we'll take care of you.

## Services
- Diagnostics and repairs: Check engine light on? Our technicians track down the problem and fix it at a fair and just price.
- Factory-scheduled maintenance: Keep your car on its maintenance schedule, with your service records kept on file here.
- Tires and alignment: Worn tires or a car that pulls out of alignment? Bring it in and we'll sort it out.
- VIP Oil Change Reward Club: Purchase 6 basic or full-synthetic oil changes at regular prices and your next oil change service is free.
- VIP Tire Club: Purchase 4 new tires of any brand and you'll receive 4 tire rotates with them.
- Road Hazard Warranty Protection Plan: Includes tire replacement when a tire is damaged by a road hazard and can't be repaired.
- Fuel Rewards Network: Join Fuel Rewards Network and lower your fuel costs when you fill up with us.

## FAQ
Q: Will I know what the work costs before you start?
A: Yes. All estimates are explained ahead of time, so you can decide before any work begins.

Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. All work is covered by a 12-month / 12,000-mile warranty.

Q: Do you accept extended warranty contracts?
A: We do. Give us a call and we'll help you get your vehicle serviced.

Q: How do I request service?
A: You can request service online or call us directly at 952-890-9988.
